overview_description.description: avendi is a hospitality technology company that develops software used by hotels and similar businesses to manage guest services and operational workflows. The system allows guests to submit service requests (such as room service or housekeeping), which are routed to hotel staff through a web or mobile interface. Staff can view incoming requests, assign tasks, update statuses, and monitor completion in real time.
